title: Six Sigma Black Belt – ASQ
overview: Six Sigma Black Belt is a known technique for process improvement. Strategies related to six sigma seek to improve the output quality of a process by identifying and eliminating causes of defects and minimising variability in business processes. Six Sigma encompasses various quality management methods (empirical, statistical, etc.).
Each Six Sigma project undertaken follows a distinct sequence of steps with specific value targets of reducing process time and costs and increasing customer satisfaction and profits.

What does a Six Sigma black belt do? A Six Sigma black belt possesses a thorough understanding of all aspects of lean six sigma methods, including a high level of subject matter competence with regard to DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control).
audience: Senior leaders and managers of organisations who should thoroughly understand the importance of employing lean six sigma processes
Project managers and other members/professionals handling projects and/or operations within the organisation
Quality managers who need to ensure quality management at all stages of a project
Software testers and analysts responsible for testing and ensuring no errors in the entire cycle
Process improvement experts who check and provide suggestions related to changes in existing processes and systems within the team and/or organisation
Any other professional who would like to know more about lean six sigma black belt training
methodology: Lectures are delivered by experienced professionals, using audio-visual presentations for ease of reference. Two-way participation is ensured through group assignments and activities. Relevant case studies are also discussed to foster relevance to the training content.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: complete knowledge and understanding of six sigma black belt training
the required confidence, experience and skill to undertake the lean six sigma black belt exam and successfully clear it
the confidence and knowledge to train other professionals for implementing six sigma for their work
the exposure, experience, capabilities and perspective to identify and resolve quality-related issues being faced by the organisation
adequate decision-making and problem-solving skills to address a problem
the ability and skillset to contribute to organisational development through high quality and accuracy
the confidence and perspective to oversee, audit and manage process practices and improve performance
satisfaction from supporting organisational growth through increased quality and greater accuracy
skill to ensure better project outcome and happier end-users/customers because of a high level of quality and accuracy
